title: Sports-QA: A Large-Scale Video Question Answering Benchmark for Complex and Professional Sports

bias_targets.methodology: Generating meta-questions by removing team information and action order to evaluate the correlation between questions and answers, and randomly removing over-represented QA pairs to ensure no answer frequency exceeds 0.5, thereby preventing models from exploiting spurious correlations.

Actively promoting diversity in sports categories and specific sports actions during dataset construction to ensure a balanced representation across different sports (e.g., balancing the number of questions across basketball, football, volleyball, and gymnastics).
